{{Quote|Hmph. Like father, like son. Always picking the wrong side|Salus Bralor to Torian Cadera|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Salus Bralor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of [[Clan Bralor/Legends|Clan Bralor]] who was the father of [[Jogo]]. After learning that his son was killed by the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]], he went to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to confront him. He challenged the hunter to a blood duel, but was killed in the duel by the champion and [[Torian Cadera]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|brown and gold]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Salus Bralor will only fight you above Taris if you killed his son, Jogo. However, he will still appear on the orbital station if you do not kill Jogo, but he will not do anything.
